feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 June 2026 5:27am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 30 June 2026 at 5:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Area of low pressure and associated frontal zone will move eastwards across the area today, then a ridge of high pressure will build tonight.


##Wind##

South 4 or 5 this morning, occasionally 6 in the west of the area at first. Decreasing South or Southwest 3 or 4 through the afternoon, veering West or Northwest later in the evening. Increasing Northwest 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight for a time later today and at first tonight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle, then becoming fair later this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, backing and decreasing West 3 or 4 tomorrow morning. Gradually backing and increasing South or Southwest 5 or 6 during the afternoon and evening, possibly occasionally 7 for a time overnight, then veering West or Northwest 5 or 6 later in night.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight for a time, then building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy rain for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
